lambda_screen.rule: M λ chosen BEFORE M trajectories 1–2 (PI instruction, 2026-10-29) by the §8 metric — mean over dev1–3 of relative Δ(160) = (s160 − r160)/r160 vs the R0 mean — computed on trajectory 0 only (the only M data then available; one trajectory per split for each λ ∈ {0.03, 0.3, 3}); highest mean wins. Trajectories 1–2 were then run for the chosen λ only, so later all-trajectory means are not a like-for-like comparison across λ.
